scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && npm run prisma:migrate:dev
scripts.azurite:reset: bash -lc "docker compose stop azurite >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker compose rm -f azurite >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; vol=$(docker volume ls -q --filter name=azurite-data); if [ -n \"$vol\" ]; then docker volume rm $vol; fi; docker compose up -d azurite"
